title: Parametrized mate core for internal adjunction evaluation
statement: The tensor-Hom transpose of the parametrized conjugate of the projection map is projection followed by tensor transpose and exceptional counit.

source.place: Proof, last paragraph: evaluation and exceptional counit underlying the internal adjunction; see also prop-asd-internal-adjunction proof, displayed Hom bijections

proof.text: Expand the parametrized conjugate and use conjugateEquiv counit naturality to identify its transpose with projection followed by tensor transpose and exceptional counit.

split_report.summary: Expanded the canonical Hom-bijection construction and evaluated its action on an arbitrary map h. All ingredients are existing nodes; no new node, no changed statement, no Lean writing or compilation. Checked constant finite coefficients and unbounded ordinary etale typing, the proper/open projection normalization, and the direction of exceptional counit transposition.
